messages:
Maya: Quick kickoff 90min 0 sync. Need a compact field asset: one-page sales brief + 3 deck hero slides + a short webinar blurb. Focus: security, SLA guarantees, and deployment choices.
Diego: I'll draft the one-pager. Thinking sections: lead problem statement, our approach, deployment matrix, quick benchmark callout, and sales routing. Keep it skimmable.
Harper: For the benchmark callout use a narrative instead of hard numbers: "Customer X reduced latency variability and regained predictability in peak traffic by switching to reserved pools and intelligent caching". That avoids claims but tells a clear story.
Leo: On the deployment matrix: rows = Hosted / Dedicated / Private; columns = Speed to ship, Cost predictability, Data controls, Ops overhead. Short phrases only. I can make a 3x4 grid mock.
Nina: Webinar hook ideas: 1) short customer pain story (ops scramble during outage) 2) demo of routing + fallback (hosted -> dedicated -> private) 3) live Q&A on security/SLA tradeoffs. Title idea: "Production-Grade LLM Inference: Security, SLAs, Deployment Patterns".
Maya: Let's A/B test two headlines on registration page: 
A) "Enterprise-grade inference: secure & SLA-backed"
B) "Predictable LLM performance at scale"
Diego: Drafted CTAs: "Request capacity review", "Schedule security walkthrough". Also include an objection handling snippet: "We never train customer data by default; you can opt into private control plane and KMS-backed keys. Full audit trail available."
Harper: Routing rules for inbound leads (examples for ops):
```
- keywords: ["security","compliance","fedramp","sox"]
  route_to: "ae_security_queue"
- keywords: ["sla","p95","throughput","latency"]
  route_to: "enterprise_sales_queue"
- keywords: ["vpc","on-prem","private","air-gapped"]
  route_to: "platform_sales_queue"
- fallback: "growth_sales"
```
Leo: Also include a short technical appendix link and a Figma frame link for the one-pager mock. I'll upload slides after the grid is ready.
Nina: For webinar promo copy (one paragraph): "Join us for a 30-minute session where our engineering leads break down how teams achieve reliable LLM inference under security constraints, align SLAs with business needs, and pick the right deployment mode. Live demo + audience Q&A."
Maya: Timeline: Diego to provide draft one-pager by Tue 17:00 UTC, Leo to push initial matrix + slides Wed 11:00 UTC, Harper to review benchmark language before publish. ops-bot: Reminder set - draft due Tue 17:00 UTC; slides due Wed 11:00 UTC.
Diego: Will include speaker notes for each slide and 2 suggested social blurbs. Sharing draft link when ready.
Maya: Perfect. Keep the one-pager under 500 words total. Focus on objections from security/compliance buyers and provide clear next steps for sales. :white_check_mark:
